Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Anil - 32 years, son
Look: white kurta-pyjama
2. Neeta - 60 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Sonali - 25 years, daughter
Look: red salwar-kameez
4. Anita - 36 years, friend
Look: green saree
5. Ajay - 27 years, friend
Look: light beard, green T-shirt

Places

1. The temple - stone pillars, a big bell
2. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand

Scene 1: The temple - Day

[Anil stands in the temple. Neeta stands near him.]

Anil: "Today feels like a good day."

[Anil rings the temple bell.]

Anil (surprised): "What next?"

[Anil folds his hands and prays.]

Anil: "Oh wow!"

[Anil kneels before the idol.]

Anil: "This is amazing!"

Scene 2: The hospital ward - Day

[Anil stands in the ward. Neeta stands near him.]

Anil: "What a nice place."

[Anil checks Mother's pulse.]

Anil: "Yes, all right."

[Anil lies down on the hospital bed.]

Anil: "Mom, look at this."

[Anil sits in a wheelchair.]

Anil: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Anil walks to the reception desk and asks for the doctor.]

Neeta: "Good job, Anil!"

[Anil coughs and holds his chest.]

Anil (softly): "That was such a fun day!"
